raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Split the DeepSeek-V4-Flash W8A8 8P accuracy test case changes out of #43063 so they can be tracked and iterated on separately. #43063 now only carries the DeepSeek-V2-Lite-W8A8 cleanup.

## Modifications

- `test/registered/npu/accuracy/deepseek_v4_flash/test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_8p_gpqa.py`:
  - Register the case to `base-c-test-acc-16-npu-a3` so it runs in the PR pipeline (`est_time=3600`).
  - Identify the invoking pipeline by requiring `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME == pull_request` and excluding the nightly workflow via `GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF`, so local runs and other workflows keep the full nightly profile instead of silently downgrading to the PR smoke profile.
  - On the PR pipeline run a 300-question GSM8K subset with a 0.93 threshold (relaxed from 0.95: the official report lists 91.1 on BF16 8-shot, while our 0-shot CoT evalscope runs measured 0.98, and 0.95 left too little headroom for sampling noise on the 300-question subset); the nightly pipeline keeps the full GPQA run (0.874).
  - Drop the obsolete `nightly-acc-16-npu-a3-cann910` registration.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A - CI registration and dataset selection only; no model or kernel behavior change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -13,16 +13,18 @@
 from sglang.test.test_utils import DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
 from sglang.utils import wait_for_server
 
+register_npu_ci(est_time=3600, suite="base-c-test-acc-16-npu-a3")
+
 register_npu_ci(
     est_time=3600,
     suite="nightly-acc-16-npu-a3",
     nightly=True,
 )
 
-register_npu_ci(
-    est_time=7200,
-    suite="nightly-acc-16-npu-a3-cann910",
-    nightly=True,
+# Nightly is also PR-triggered, so exclude it by workflow ref; every other caller
+# (local runs, full test) still gets the full run.
+_is_pr_pipeline = os.environ.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME") == "pull_request" and (
+    "nightly-test-npu.yml" not in os.environ.get("GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF", "")
 )
 
 DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_DSPARK_8P_ENVS = {
@@ -136,10 +138,11 @@ class TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashW8A88PGPQA(TestNpuAccuracyTestCaseBase):
     model = DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_0731_W8A8_MODEL_PATH
     other_args = DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_DSPARK_8P_OTHER_ARGS
     envs = DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_DSPARK_8P_ENVS
-    accuracy = 0.874
-    datasets = ["gpqa_diamond"]
+    accuracy = 0.93 if _is_pr_pipeline else 0.874
+    datasets = ["gsm8k"] if _is_pr_pipeline else ["gpqa_diamond"]
     few_shot_num = 0
     generation_config = DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_GENERATION_CONFIG_HIGH
+    limit = 300 if _is_pr_pipeline else 100000
     eval_batch_size = 128
     stream = True
     timeout = 6000
